newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Napa Valley USD, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Napa Valley USD, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Napa Valley Unified School District (the
intends to offer for public sale on

at the hour of 10:00 A.M. at the offices of Stradling, Yocca, Carlson & Rauth, a Professional Corporation, 44 Montgomery Street, Suite 2950, San Francisco, California 94104 $4,600,000 principal amount of general obligation bonds of the District designated Napa Valley Unified School District (Napa County, California) Election of 1996 General Obligation Bonds Series B'' (the Bonds''). Within 26 hours, the Treasurer-Tax Collector of Napa County, or his designee, in conjunction with the Superintendent of the District, will consider the bids received and, if an acceptable bid is received, award the sale of the Bonds on the basis of the net interest cost. In the event that no bid is awarded by the designated time, proposals will be received the following Wednesday at the same time and place specified above and each Wednesday thereafter until such time as a bid is awarded or notice to the contrary is given. NOTICE IS HEREBY FURTHER GIVEN that the Bonds, dated August 1, 1997, will be offered for public sale subject to the terms and conditions of the Notice Inviting Bids for the Bonds, dated July 9, 1997. An Official Statement and a Notice Inviting Bids relating to the Bonds will be furnished upon request mailed to A. G. Edwards & Sons, Inc., 111 West Ocean Boulevard, Suite 1150, Long Beach, California 90802, the financial advisor to the District for the Bonds.
